prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

(CNN) -- Police in Boston, Massachusetts, are searching for a man suspected in the murder of one woman and the armed robbery of two others, all of whom, they say, he may have met through their Craigslist ads for personal services. Julissa Brisman, 26, was described as "a really sweet, goofy, energetic kid." Officers discovered New York resident Julissa Brisman, 26, unconscious with multiple gunshot wounds at Boston's Copley Marriott Hotel on Tuesday night. She was transferred to Boston Medical Center, where she died shortly afterward. Police said Brisman, a model, offered massages via Craigslist, a popular online classified ad service. The confrontation between Brisman and her killer seems to have begun as an attempted robbery, police said. "It appears that there was a struggle between the victim and the suspect in the threshold of the hotel room immediately prior to the shooting," the Boston Police Department said in a statement on its Web site. Police speculate the man may also be responsible for the recent robberies of two other young women who offered personal services via Craigslist. Four days before Brisman's slaying, a 29-year-old woman was robbed at gunpoint at a Westin Hotel in Boston. Police spokesman Joe Zanola would not disclose the details of her Craigslist ad but said she and Brisman were "involved in similar professions." On Thursday night at a Holiday Inn Express in Warwick, Rhode Island, a man tied up and demanded money from a 26-year-old dancer who had posted a Craigslist advertisement, according to Warwick's police chief, Col. Stephen McCartney. The robbery was interrupted when the woman's husband entered the room. After pointing his gun at the husband, the suspect fled, according to McCartney. He said that no conclusions could be made but allowed that the incident "may be related to similar crimes occurring in the Boston area." Matthew Terhune, a photographer who met Brisman when he took pictures of her for a calendar last year, described her as "just a really sweet, goofy, energetic kid." He added that she was enrolled in Alcoholics Anonymous and was contemplating counseling fellow recovering addicts. He had been unaware of her side job as an Internet masseuse. Surveillance videos from the hotel where Brisman was murdered showed a tall, clean-cut young blond man in a black windbreaker leaving the property, said the Boston Police Department, which is asking the public's help in identifying the man. Representatives from Craigslist did not respond to a request for comment.

Although he emphasized that no conclusions could yet be drawn, McCartney acknowledged that the incident “may be related to similar crimes occurring in the Boston area.”

Matthew Terhune, a photographer who met Brisman while taking pictures of her for a calendar last year, described her as “just a really sweet, goofy, energetic kid.” He said she was enrolled in Alcoholics Anonymous and was considering counseling other recovering addicts. Surveillance video from the hotel where Brisman was killed showed a tall, clean-cut young blond man wearing a black windbreaker leaving the property, according to the Boston Police Department, which is seeking the public’s help in identifying him.

**BOSTON —** Police in Massachusetts and Rhode Island are investigating whether one man used Craigslist advertisements to target three women in a series of hotel attacks, including the fatal shooting of a woman in Boston.

Investigators are comparing evidence from two incidents at Boston hotels with a third attack in Warwick, Rhode Island. Authorities have not established publicly that the same person carried out all three crimes, but similarities in the victims, the way meetings were arranged and descriptions of the assailant have prompted coordination among law-enforcement agencies.

The most serious attack occurred at Boston’s Marriott Copley Place, where 25-year-old Julissa Brisman was found shot inside a hotel room. Police said Brisman had advertised massage services on Craigslist and apparently arranged to meet a customer at the hotel.

Several days earlier, another woman who had posted services on Craigslist was allegedly confronted and robbed at gunpoint at the nearby Westin Copley Place. That victim survived.

Police are also examining an attack at a hotel in Warwick, where a woman who had advertised online was reportedly held at gunpoint. The confrontation was interrupted when another person entered the room, and the assailant fled after firing a weapon, according to accounts of the incident. No one was reported killed in that case.

Authorities are reviewing hotel surveillance recordings, online communications, telephone records and physical evidence to determine whether the attacks are connected. Images released by police show a clean-cut young man walking through a hotel, but investigators cautioned that surveillance photographs alone do not prove involvement in a crime.

The possibility that the women were selected through Craigslist has raised concerns about the risks of meeting strangers contacted through online classified advertisements. Investigators are seeking records that could identify the person who responded to the women’s postings and arranged the hotel meetings.

Police have urged anyone who recognizes the man shown in surveillance images, or who may have had a suspicious encounter after posting an advertisement online, to contact authorities. They also advised people arranging meetings with strangers to do so in public, inform someone of their plans and avoid isolated locations.

Craigslist has previously said it cooperates with lawful police investigations and provides safety guidance to users. There is no indication that the company had prior knowledge of the attacks.

The investigation remains active, and police have not announced a definitive connection among all three cases. Authorities stressed that descriptions of a possible suspect and the circumstances surrounding the attacks remain allegations unless supported by evidence and established in court.

### Online Ads Linked to Killing of New York Model in Boston Hotel

**BOSTON —** Twenty-six-year-old model and masseuse Julissa Brisman was found fatally shot inside a room at Boston’s Copley Marriott hotel on April 14, 2009, after arranging an appointment through an online advertisement, authorities said.

Boston police responding to reports of a disturbance discovered Brisman near the doorway of the room. She had been shot and suffered blunt-force injuries. Investigators said she appeared to have fought with her attacker during an attempted robbery.

Police linked the killing to another attack four days earlier at Boston’s Westin Copley Place. In that case, a woman who had advertised massage services online was robbed at gunpoint and bound. Surveillance images showed a clean-cut young man using a cellphone in both hotels, leading detectives to believe the crimes were connected.

Matthew Terhune, a photographer who had worked with Brisman, remembered her as an outgoing and kind young woman trying to build a career in New York. His description contrasted sharply with the impersonal way her killer allegedly found her—through a Craigslist advertisement offering massage services.

Two days after Brisman’s death, a similar confrontation occurred at a Holiday Inn Express in Warwick, Rhode Island. Police said a man responding to an online advertisement pulled a gun on a woman and attempted to restrain her with plastic ties. He fled when the woman’s husband entered the room.

Warwick Police Chief Stephen McCartney said the unexpected interruption may have saved the woman’s life. Evidence and surveillance footage from the Rhode Island encounter helped investigators connect the attacks, police said.

Authorities later arrested Boston University medical student Philip Markoff and charged him with Brisman’s murder, armed robbery and other offenses. Police said electronic records, hotel video and additional evidence tied him to the three incidents. He pleaded not guilty.

Markoff died by suicide in jail in August 2010 while awaiting trial. Because the case never went before a jury, he was not convicted of Brisman’s murder. The charges were subsequently dismissed, leaving the criminal case formally unresolved by a verdict.
